title: PR 4b — employee API + privacy (masked GET, strict PUT, audited reveal, PII encryption)

goals.text: GET employees/[id] returns the masked profile; PUT is a strict schema (unknown keys 400) with per-market tax-id (TFN/SIN/SSN), account-number-only bank and routing-label validation, masked echoes never overwrite stored values, and a jurisdiction change with a stored tax id requires re-entry; every change writes an audit row of field names only.

TFN/SIN/SSN, bank and super member numbers are AES-256-GCM encrypted and fail closed (503 pii_key_unconfigured, nothing written) without a key in production/preview; responses and the tenant export carry last4/flags only, never ciphertext; the observability scrubber redacts the new fields; reveal is owner-only, rate-limited, tenant-scoped and writes its audit row before the value leaves.

launch.rollback: Revert the PR. The 4a schema (AbEmployeeSensitive, AbEmployeeChange, profile columns) is additive and stays, unused. Sensitive values already written stay encrypted in AbEmployeeSensitive and are never returned; GET/PUT employees/[id] go back to the previous unmasked, unvalidated behaviour and the reveal route disappears. No caller sent PUT before this PR.
